verdict.rationale: Zoho CRM documents its own data export (capped at 10 free exports on the pricing page) and an asynchronous bulk API for retrieving large amounts of data, so exporting data is a first-party capability. The evidence never names the export formats, though, and doesn't show a complete, all-data export path for leaving the platform. missing for 10: explicit open-format export (e.g. CSV/JSON) documentation, evidence of a complete full-account export including attachments/metadata, clarity on export limits beyond the free tier, independent or hands-on corroboration of a clean exit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Export data from Zoho CRM for up to 10 times for free.
An asynchronous API, used to push or retrieve large amounts of data to and from Zoho CRM, through a single API call.
It retrieves all available standard, subform, linking (MxN), and custom modules in your organization.
